assertions.claim: Musica is the stratum where the text cannot compress: it is the dominant stratum of the compressed core.
Musica alone carries roughly 47% of the compressed core, so Musica-Original sets ND almost single-handedly.
The intensity ladder exercises all four rungs in one poem: Stock, Implied, Selected, Original each appear.
SCR is near-minimal for an observation-transmission telos: under 2 on the argumentative bands, close to irreducible.
RI is not zero: Arithmetica is Stock and two strata are Implied, so about a fifth of the core is substrate-reachable.
The Musica-Original worked example ranks in the top quartile of block B (working markdown) on the mechanical Musica measure.
Sprung rhythm was historically new prosody: Musica reads Original, not Selected. The rhythm is originated, not chosen from a known inventory.
Astronomia reads Implied, not Original: the praise-poem arc (laudes, exempla, causa, laudes) is conventional for devotional lyric. The novelty is in the rhythm, not the arc.
